title: Page 120
transc:
HdQrs AP Jany 10th 1015 AM
Able Am making my arrangements
in accordance with my letter
Reports of poplars indicate that
a portion or all of
Whiff corps is ordered to
Durham I will probably know
to night or tomorrow &
will in form you Argyle


Head Quarters January 13th 215 PM 1863 
for Ordnance Fair facts Court
House the Comdg Quarrel directs
that you have your command 
ready to move on twelve
hours with three days Cooked
rations in haversacks and from
six to eight days bread
and small rations in wagons
with beef cattle for that
length of time Notice will
be given you in time
to have the rations Cooked
signed <deletion>Ap</deletion> <insertion>Alps</insertion> Chief of Staff
